declare

 nullchk;

 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0210');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;

 end;
 end if;

 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin

 -- Check for CUE. CUE check is checked for
 -- by the previous select also.
 --
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date)
 and donor_decision_code is not null
 and donor_decision_code != 'X';
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then

 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0053');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 -- Check whether unit has any label components
 begin
 select count(*)
 into temp_count
 from components
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date)
 and system_label_decision is not null
 and label_dats is not null;
 if temp_count > 0 then
 show_error('0106');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;

end;

declare
 temp_dd_code VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_dd_code_desc VARCHAR2(50);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 if NVL(length(:s_dd), 0) != 7
 then
 show_error('1210');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 if NVL(length(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_id), 0) = 7
 then
 validate_dd_scan_codabar(:s_dd,temp_dd_code,
 temp_dd_code_desc);
 else
 validate_dd_scan_code128(:s_dd,temp_dd_code,
 temp_dd_code_desc);
 end if;
 :donor_decision_code := temp_dd_code;
 if temp_dd_code in ('Y','N')
 then
 temp_dd_code_desc := 'Done';
 end if;
 :s_donor_decision_code_desc := temp_dd_code_desc;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 if :donor_decision_code not in ('A','S','N','T','O','Y')
 then
 :s_donor_decision_code_desc := '';
 show_error('1160');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 if :donor_decision_code = :s_old_donor_decision_code
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_dd');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0125');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 if :donor_decision_code = 'A'
 then
 :s_donor_decision_code_desc := 'Ambiguous';
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'S'
 then
 :s_donor_decision_code_desc := 'Autologous';
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'T'
 then
 :s_donor_decision_code_desc := 'Therapeutic';
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'O'
 then
 :s_donor_decision_code_desc := 'No Cue';
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'N'
 then
 :s_donor_decision_code_desc := 'Done';
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'Y'
 then
 :s_donor_decision_code_desc := 'Done';
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

declare
 temp_count number;
 --t_local_time date;
begin
-- :units.unit_id := :units.unit_id;
 :s_old_donor_decision_code := :donor_decision_code;
 begin
 select site_name
 into :s_site_name
 from group_sites
 where group_site_id = :group_site_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select code_desc
 into :s_abo_desc
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'ABO'
 and code = :donor_form_abo
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select code_desc
 into :s_bag_code_desc
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'BAG'
 and code = :bag_code
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'A'
 then
 :s_donor_decision_code_desc := 'Ambiguous';
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'S'
 then
 :s_donor_decision_code_desc := 'Autologous';
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'T'
 then
 :s_donor_decision_code_desc := 'Therapeutic';
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'N'
 then
 :s_donor_decision_code_desc := 'Done';
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'Y'
 then
 :s_donor_decision_code_desc := 'Done';
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'O'
 then
 :s_donor_decision_code_desc := 'No Cue';
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'X'
 then
 :s_donor_decision_code_desc := 'N/A';
 end if;
 /*
 -- Added by Kishore on 03/07/2011 for timezone change
 if is_timezone_enabled and :units.bleed_start_time is not null and
 to_char(:units.bleed_start_time, 'HH24:MI:SS') != '00:00:00' then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :units.bleed_start_time, t_local_time);
 :units.d_bleed_start_time := t_local_time;
 end if;
 
 t_local_time := null;
 if is_timezone_enabled and :units.bleed_end_time is not null and
 to_char(:units.bleed_end_time, 'HH24:MI:SS') != '00:00:00' then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :units.bleed_end_time, t_local_time);
 :units.d_bleed_end_time := t_local_time;
 end if;
 -- End of change
 */
 IF is_timezone_enabled THEN
 if :units.bleed_start_time is not null and
 to_char(:units.bleed_start_time, 'HH24:MI:SS') != '00:00:00' then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :units.bleed_start_time, :units.d_bleed_start_time);
 end if;
 if :units.bleed_end_time is not null and
 to_char(:units.bleed_end_time, 'HH24:MI:SS') != '00:00:00' then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :units.bleed_end_time, :units.d_bleed_end_time);
 end if;
 if :units.qc_checkin_date is not null then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :units.qc_checkin_date, :units.d_qc_checkin_date); 
 end if;
 ELSE
 :units.d_bleed_start_time := :units.bleed_start_time;
 :units.d_bleed_end_time := :units.bleed_end_time;
 :units.d_qc_checkin_date := :units.qc_checkin_date;
 END IF;
end;
